offering_description.value: Haemonetics sells devices, single-use supplies and software to hospitals, plasma collection centers and blood centers. It develops and manufactures products for blood and plasma collection, transfusion management, and surgical and interventional care.

primary_products.value: Blood and plasma apheresis systems and disposables; coagulation testing and surgical blood salvage systems; vascular closure, pressure-sensing and esophageal cooling devices; donor management software; transfusion management software

primary_services.value: Equipment maintenance and repair; software implementation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, plasma collection operators and blood centers

end_markets.value: Hospital surgery and transfusion medicine; interventional cardiology and electrophysiology; plasma collection for plasma-derived therapies; blood banking

revenue_model.value: product sales: Medical equipment and recurring purchases of single-use collection, testing and procedural supplies; licensing or royalties: Donor, plasma center and transfusion management software; service fees: Equipment maintenance and repair
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Makes medical equipment and single-use supplies for hospitals, plasma centers and blood centers; software / platform: Develops donor, collection and transfusion workflow software for plasma centers, blood centers and hospitals

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific, including Japan and China

specialization.value: related lines: Hospital blood management, interventional devices, plasma collection, blood center apheresis and workflow software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving hospitals, plasma collection operators and blood centers; distributors / dealers: Medical device distributors in selected international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medical devices and diagnostics subject to FDA oversight and EU medical device and in vitro diagnostic regulations

notes: The current relative scale of the hospital and plasma collection businesses is uncertain.
